title: Sportswear HO19 / Court Vision Lo black shoe layout

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Give product naming and campaign messaging different voices so viewers can distinguish identification from persuasion.
strategic_value: Brush-like black naming inside the photo border can make the product feel personally selected, while the broad white headline keeps the campaign assertive.
demonstration: A taped photograph of black Court Vision Lo shoes sits above a handwritten-style product name; a wide white headline and smaller sentence sit below the frame.
practical_value: Compare informal product labeling with a bold campaign headline in one hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Taped product photograph
content_islands.spec: Center the black-shoe photograph inside a pale instant-photo-style frame with tape at the top.

content_islands.name: Product name
content_islands.spec: Set the black brush-like name inside the lower frame margin.

content_islands.name: Campaign statement
content_islands.spec: Place the white headline and smaller explanatory sentence below the frame, with the Nike signature beneath.

content_islands.name: Background collage
content_islands.spec: Layer coral texture, court photography and a partial wearer image behind the frame.

reference_purposes.Expression: A taped photograph of black Court Vision Lo shoes sits above a handwritten-style product name; a wide white headline and smaller sentence sit below the frame.

ingredient.name: Taped photo frame and product label
ingredient.role: Make the shoe the focal item while separating its name from the campaign promise.
ingredient.application: In this example, place the product photograph and brush-like label inside a pale frame, with tape above and the campaign headline below.
ingredient.scope: Observed Sportswear Core Holiday 2019 composition. No universal frame size, typeface or placement rule is supplied.
